tldr: Headlines across eight countries uniformly announced the Twin Falls In-N-Out shooting as a lethal public-safety event, but US conservative coverage (Daily Wire) recast the identical incident as a civilian-hero self-defense vindication story, The Independent (UK) led with victim humanization, and RT (Russia) deployed sensationalist 'chaotic shootout' language — all divergences invisible until the headline layer is isolated.

single_outlet_findings.finding: The only outlet to place the word 'Hero' in the headline itself, advertising the event as a self-defense vindication story before the reader clicks — a framing choice absent from every international headline.
The only outlet to foreground victim humanization in the headline ('was working her first ever job'), centering human cost rather than the mechanics or perpetrator of the shooting.
The only outlet to use 'chaotic shootout' and 'burger joint' with '(VIDEOS)' appended — a sensationalist register implying mutual armed exchange from the start, absent from all other coverage.
The only outlet to headline the false-identification misinformation angle (Amer Mandzic), surfacing a secondary social-harm story entirely invisible in every other outlet's headline coverage.

bottom_line: At the headline layer, six of eight country buckets reported the Idaho shooting as a factual public-safety event; only Daily Wire's headlines recast it as civilian-hero self-defense vindication, marking the sharpest ideological divergence in this cluster's headline-vs-body framing.
